steps.name: Verify current owner provenance without restoring retired repositories
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PYCODE'
import json, os, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
record = Path('source-consolidation.json')
assert record.is_file() and not record.is_symlink() and record.stat().st_size <= 65536
data = json.loads(record.read_text())
assert data['owner_repository'] == os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']
for component in data.get('components', []):
    assert component['owner_repository'] == data['owner_repository']
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', component['source_head'])
    path = PurePosixPath(component['subpath'])
    assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
    assert (Path('.') / path).is_dir()
    assert not {'history_archive', 'history_ref', 'local_history_ref'} & component.keys()
if not data.get('components'):
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', data['source_sha'])
assert 'canonical_history_bundle' not in data
paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], timeout=10).decode().split('\0')
assert len(paths) <= 8192
assert not any(p.endswith('.bundle') or 'source-history' in PurePosixPath(p).parts for p in paths if p)
print('Current owner provenance verified; no historical repository restoration')
PYCODE

steps.name: Admit the exact tag and successful default-branch CI
Build and pack the selected package without publication identity
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if test -f "$INSTALL_DIRECTORY/pnpm-lock.yaml"; then
  pnpm --dir "$INSTALL_DIRECTORY" install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
  pnpm --dir "$INSTALL_DIRECTORY" -r --include-workspace-root --if-present run build
elif test -f "$INSTALL_DIRECTORY/package-lock.json"; then
  npm --prefix "$INSTALL_DIRECTORY" ci --ignore-scripts
  npm --prefix "$INSTALL_DIRECTORY" run build --if-present
else
  echo 'A committed dependency lock is required'; exit 1
fi
git diff --exit-code
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-release"
npm_config_ignore_scripts=true pnpm --dir "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY" pack --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-release"

steps.name: Publish through the repository Trusted Publisher
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if test "$PUBLICATION_MODE" = direct; then
  npm publish "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-release/$ARCHIVE_NAME" --access public --provenance --ignore-scripts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
  python3 .github/scripts/archive_binding.py registry npm "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-release"
elif test -z "$PUBLICATION_MODE" || test "$PUBLICATION_MODE" = stage; then
  npm stage publish "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-release/$ARCHIVE_NAME" --access public --provenance --ignore-scripts --json --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org > "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-stage-response.json"
  python3 .github/scripts/stage_notification.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-release" "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-stage-response.json"
  rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-stage-response.json"
else
  echo 'Unknown NPM_PUBLICATION_MODE'; exit 1
fi
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-release/release-receipt.json" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Notify the owner issue queue without npm credentials or approval authority
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
count=$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state all --search "$STAGE_ID in:body" --json number --jq 'length')
if test "$count" = 0; then
  gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "[npm stage] Review $STAGE_ID" --body-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-stage-notice/notice.md"
fi
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-stage-notice/notice.md" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
